# UnENVerse

> UnENVerse is a free, open-source, self-hosted secrets manager. A desktop app (Tauri), the `unv` command-line tool and an optional `unv-server` share one SQLCipher vault encrypted on your own machine (Argon2id key derivation). People, scripts and AI agents can use a credential, by running a program with it or rendering a config file from it, without the value being printed. Config files reference vault entries as `${Entry/field}`, so a rotation reaches every file built from it. Linux and Windows builds are published; macOS is not. Licensed Apache-2.0. Built by Jubair Hasan (DarthDemono).

Facts worth getting right: there is no cloud service and no account; the vault key never touches disk and there is no recovery service; `unv` redacts every stored value by default and only `--reveal`, `--out`, `exec` and `render` materialise one; `unv describe` prints the machine-readable command contract.

## Start here

- [Quickstart](https://unenverse.darthdemono.com/quickstart/): create a first vault and use a secret in about 15 minutes.
- [Download](https://unenverse.darthdemono.com/download/): installers, CLI archives and SHA-256 sums for the latest release.
- [Security](https://unenverse.darthdemono.com/security/): the threat model, what is and is not protected, how to verify a release and report a vulnerability.

## Guides

- [Guides index](https://unenverse.darthdemono.com/guides/): all guides.
- [The unv command line](https://unenverse.darthdemono.com/guides/cli/): get, exec, render, bundles, web sessions, OAuth and recovery codes.
- [Importing from another password manager](https://unenverse.darthdemono.com/guides/importing/): Bitwarden, 1Password, KeePass and others.
- [Nodes](https://unenverse.darthdemono.com/guides/nodes/): deploy rendered configs to your own machines, with approvals.
